title: Recovery equation for a prescribed local map family
statement: Let $X,Y$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], $p:Y\to X$ a morphism, and $U$ an open cover of $X$. Let $F,G$ be modules on $X$, let $\delta:p^*F\to p^*G$ be a morphism of tensor pullbacks [def-pc-module-pullback], and let $r_\alpha$ be a morphism between the ordinary pullbacks of $F,G$ to each member $U_\alpha$. Define recovery of $\delta$ by $r$ to mean the following equation for every $\alpha$. Write $V=p^*U$, $s_\alpha:V_\alpha\to U_\alpha$ for the cover map, and $t_\alpha$ for the canonical restriction comparison [def-pc-open-cover-tensor-pullback-comparison]. Then $t_\alpha^{-1}(F)\circ s_\alpha^*(r_\alpha)\circ t_\alpha(G)=V_\alpha^*(\delta)$, where composition is written in diagrammatic order, from left to right. This is a predicate given by these displayed equalities; it chooses no morphism or witness.
